units: c=6piG=Ts=1; R=E[M_B]/M; late-endpoint density; same marginally bound flat-FLRW dust model. U=Ts-s, p=P/U, f=F/U, L=lambda*U^4.
formal_prediction: Rpred=1+(A log(L)+B(p,f))/sqrt(L); A=-17sqrt(6)/(10pi). B from Mellin residue deterministic finite-part integral. No coefficients fitted.

gates.improvement: Record raw and corrected separately in all cells. High-density target: each cell at lambda>=3e6 must have positive Rpred, smaller absolute mean error, and corrected mean within +/-10%. Lowest density is a stress test.

comparators: flat coefficient using same physical P,F; uncorrected; also full prediction without log with otherwise fixed constant, as a diagnostic only.
validation: Moment integrals for coefficient with two resolutions; exact expectation via conditioned 4D Poisson kernel at two resolutions and independent interval-volume method; a differential-density check cancels B. No new Poisson sample or field dynamics.
